bearingSource: OSM way 267206319 long axis 70.5°; +X points to the rounded east end of the outline (ENE), i.e. the semicircular altar apse seen on the right of photos 01–03 with the lateral apse and the two towers to its west
approximations: No published dimensions were found. The OSM outline (32.6 × 17.3 m) is a coarse rectangle with a rounded end; the body (≈ 26.3 × 12 m plus a semicircular apse) and the lateral apses are placed from the photographs. Heights are scaled from photos 01 and 02 (walls ≈ 9 m on a 1.2 m plinth, naos tower cross ≈ 25 m, pronaos tower slightly lower). Only the south-east side is photographed; the north side is mirrored and the west front is interpreted. Window frames and the painted tower friezes are simplified. The roofed buildings are not documented: the recorded titanium-zinc quantity exceeds the church roof, so the cells and gate building facing the parking lot (photo 04; OSM way 267206314, ≈ 90 m east of the church) is added in low detail: two two-storey wings with colonnaded galleries on both floors (≈ 29 × 13 m and 24 × 14 m, eave ≈ 7.8 m, hipped roofs ≈ 27° with brick chimneys and two dormers) meeting at a slight angle at the square gate tower (eave ≈ 13 m, clock, wide skirt roof, onion dome and needle spire, cross ≈ 20.5 m). Wing lengths, depths and the tower position follow the OSM outline (its small jogs simplified), heights are scaled from photo 04, the rear façades and gallery details are schematic, and the adjoining precinct buildings (not photographed) are omitted. All church roofs, cones and tower caps and the gate building's roofs, tower skirt and dome are shown in natural titanium-zinc because the photographs (2006–2009) predate the 2023 works.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografii de referință publice; dimensiunile și înălțimile sunt estimate, iar fațada nordică este interpretată. Fotografiile sunt anterioare lucrărilor, de aceea acoperișurile, conurile absidelor și coifurile turlelor sunt redate din titan-zinc natural (elZinc Natural), livrat de COLOR METAL conform evidențelor sale; cum cantitatea înregistrată depășește acoperișul bisericii, este inclusă, simplificat, și clădirea chiliilor cu turnul de poartă dinspre parcare, cu acoperișurile, streașina turnului și bulbul din același titan-zinc natural.
note.hu: Nyilvános referenciafotók alapján értelmezett makett; a méretek és magasságok becsültek, az északi homlokzat értelmezett. A fotók a munkálatok előttiek, ezért a tetők, az apszisok kúpjai és a tornyok sisakjai natúr titáncinkből (elZinc Natural) jelennek meg, amelyet a COLOR METAL szállított nyilvántartása szerint; mivel a nyilvántartott mennyiség meghaladja a templom tetejét, egyszerűsítve a parkoló felőli cellaépület is szerepel kaputornyával együtt, tetői, a torony szoknyateteje és hagymakupolája ugyanabból a natúr titáncinkből.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from public reference photographs; dimensions and heights are estimated and the north side is interpreted. The photographs predate the works, so the roofs, apse cones and tower caps are shown in natural titanium-zinc (elZinc Natural) supplied by COLOR METAL according to its records; as the recorded quantity exceeds the church roof, the cells and gate building facing the parking lot is also included in simplified form, with the same natural titanium-zinc on its roofs, tower skirt and onion dome.
